newsitem.title: USA: Plaintffs rest case in Simpson civil trial.
newsitem.headline: Plaintffs rest case in Simpson civil trial.

text.p: Lawyers for the plaintiffs rested their case Monday in the O.J. Simpson civil trial.
After presenting 65 witnesses in six weeks, the plaintiffs concluded their case hearing emotional testimony from murder victim Ron Goldman's father Fred. The defence immediately began its case.
Simpson, a former football star-turned-actor, was acquitted by a criminal court jury last year of murdering his ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman, her friend.
He is being sued by the victims' families who contend he is responsible for the deaths and are seeking damages.

After breaking down in tears several times, Fred Goldman glared directly at Simpson across the courtroom when he spoke about an Egyptian symbol for eternal life that his son always wore around his neck.
Defence lawyer Robert Baker briefly cross-examined Goldman and then immediately began his case, calling to the stand a retired police detective, Philip Vannatter.
